goal: Correlate Claude Max unexpected weekly quota resets

Dave reports this is the third apparent reset this week after twice reaching 100%. Anthropic's published normal behavior says five-hour session resets plus a fixed assigned weekly reset time, so do not label this a normal weekly reset and do not infer account compromise. Done when we can distinguish provider-side quota refresh, UI/accounting recalculation, or display defect with evidence.
